findings.title: Unverified guarantee of returns
findings.detail: The copy includes an absolute claim about financial outcomes. Northstar policy requires a documented, approved substantiation before such claims can be used.
findings.fix: Remove the guarantee or submit evidence for mandatory legal review.

findings.title: Mandatory risk disclosure absent
findings.detail: Investment-related claims require an approved risk disclaimer in the same content version.
findings.fix: Add the approved risk disclaimer and rerun validation.

findings.title: Weighted character limit exceeded
findings.detail: This cross-platform variant may exceed X-specific publishing constraints.

findings.title: Potential safe-area crop
findings.detail: The primary visual may crop inside selected feed layouts.
findings.fix: Verify the platform crop before approval.

findings.title: Missing alternative text
findings.detail: The campaign attachment requires descriptive alternative text.
findings.fix: Add meaningful alt text describing the core visual.

findings.title: Unsupported external link formatting
findings.detail: The draft references link formatting that may not be clickable in an Instagram caption.
findings.fix: Use an approved profile link or platform-supported destination.
